faq_heading: Highgate real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Highgate. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Highgate, Burnaby: 6 houses and 71 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 2 and 9 sold in the month. It is one of 35 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Burnaby.
Highgate homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Highgate, September 2026. Detached houses: 6 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 33%. Condos and townhomes: 71 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 7 in June to 6 in September (−14.3%), and it took 3.0% of the city’s 199 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 85 in June to 71 in September (−16.5%), and it took 6.8% of the city’s 750 sales over the period.
Highgate share of Burnaby listings and sales by month

In Highgate, its share of the houses listed in Burnaby went from 1.5% in June to 1.3% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 6.2% to 5.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

Highgate condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Highgate?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses and 71 condos and townhomes listed in Highgate. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Highgate a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type; condos and townhomes had 13% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Highgate from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses and 51 condos and townhomes sold in Highgate over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 16 sold.

faq.q: How big is Highgate compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, Highgate held 1.3% of the 458 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 5.3% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Highgate?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 7.8% of the 77 homes listed in Highgate and condos and townhomes made up 92.2%; of the 11 that sold, houses were 18.2% and condos and townhomes 81.8%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Highgate than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 7 in June to 6 in September 2026 (−14.3%); condos and townhomes fell from 85 in June to 71 in September 2026 (−16.5%).
